The changes are complete. Here's a summary of what I did across the two source files (no test files touched):

**`packages/core/src/tools/grep.ts`**
- Renamed the `GrepToolParams` field `include` → `include_pattern`.
- `execute()` now passes `this.params.include_pattern` as the `include` filter to `performGrepSearch` (which restricts the git-grep/system-grep/JS-fallback searches to matching files).
- `getDescription()` now appends ` in <glob>` using `include_pattern`, and still appends the directory path (` within <dir>`) so both appear when both are set.

**`packages/core/src/tools/ripGrep.ts`**
- Renamed the `RipGrepToolParams` field `include` → `include_pattern`.
- Both `execute()` and `enrichWithRipgrepAutoContext()` now pass `this.params.include_pattern` as the `include` filter to `performRipgrepSearch` (which maps to ripgrep's `--glob`).
- `getDescription()` now appends ` in <glob>` using `include_pattern`, plus the directory path when applicable.

`validateToolParamValues()` in both tools operates on the params object without referencing the old `include` field and returns `null` for otherwise-valid params, so it transparently accepts `include_pattern`.

I kept the internal option key named `include` inside the private `performGrepSearch`/`performRipgrepSearch` helpers, since that's an internal parameter name unrelated to the public param and not part of the requested rename.
